Plot sgRNA count distributions

Source: R/qc.R
qc_plot_count_distribution.Rd

Per-sample density of read counts of targeting sgRNAs (log10 scale), with each sample's median (dashed) and the low-count threshold (dotted). Narrow, overlapping distributions indicate even library representation.

Usage

qc_plot_count_distribution(
  counts,
  meta,
  ctrl_pattern = "NEG_CTRL",
  colour_by = "replicate",
  colours = NULL,
  facet_by = "group",
  low_threshold = 30,
  base_size = 11
)

Arguments

counts

Count matrix: data frame with columns sgRNA, Gene and one column of raw counts per sample (see section 'Count matrix').

meta

Sample table: data frame with one row per sample and columns sample_id, label, group and replicate (see section 'Sample table'). Only samples in meta are used.

ctrl_pattern

Regular expression matched against the Gene column to identify control sgRNAs (default is "NEG_CTRL", which matches the controls of all libraries shipped with crisprFlow).

colour_by

Name of the column in meta used to colour samples (default is "replicate").

colours

Optional named character vector of colours, with names matching the values of the colour_by column (e.g. c(Untreated = "#0073C2", Drug = "#CD534C")). If NULL (default), the RColorBrewer "Dark2" palette is used.

facet_by

Optional name of a column in meta used to split the plot into panels (default is "group").

low_threshold

Read count drawn as a dotted reference line (default is 30).

base_size

Base font size of the plot.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

qc_plot_count_distribution(exampleCounts, exampleSampleMeta)
